Definition: to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch
BiblicalUsage: 1) to mount and ride, ride; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to mount, mount and sit or ride; 1a2) to ride, be riding; 1a3) rider (subst); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to ride, cause to (mount and) ride; 1b2) to cause to draw (plough, etc); 1b3) to cause to ride upon (fig)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
